high_level_description: A single small terrier in a low digging pose on a grassy foreground under a pale sky, rendered in flat vivid colors on a 1600x900 landscape canvas.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale blue sky occupying upper 780px; green grass band occupying lower 120px.

elements.desc: Terrier body: compact light-tan oval, centered horizontally, base aligned to top of grass
Terrier head: smaller light-tan oval, positioned above and slightly forward of body, tilted downward
Left front leg: vertical dark-tan rectangle, angled slightly forward, extending from body base into grass
Right front leg: vertical dark-tan rectangle, angled slightly forward, mirroring left
Brown leather harness: chest strap (horizontal rectangle) and two shoulder straps (diagonal rectangles) overlaying body and head
Pale sky background: solid light blue rectangle
